messages:
Elaine (Design): Quick UX check — we're debating inline field errors vs top summary for bulk edits. Screenshot: https://img.redwood/example.png
Sam: For bulk, summary is nice, but inline prevents guesswork. Maybe both? quick + inline for first failing
Jordan (PM): Also question about required marker — asterisk vs 'Required' label. A11y concerns?
Ravi (Eng): a11y: screen readers prefer explicit "required" rather than just asterisk. We can aria-required but visible text is clearer.
Elaine (Design): +1. If we use asterisks, include text in helper: "* = required" and aria-hidden on asterisk? Not sure.
Maya (a11y-bot): Tip: Add aria-describedby linking to form-level legend that explains required. Screen reader users won't always catch color/asterisk.
Sam: What about destructive actions in form (bulk delete)? Current modal says "Delete items" only. Need typed confirm or checkbox? Thoughts
Jordan (PM): For bulk destructive, typed confirm adds friction but reduces accidents. Maybe required typed confirm only for >50 items, otherwise checkbox + undo toast.
Elaine (Design): Proposal:
```
Inline errors for short forms
Top summary + inline anchor for long/bulk forms
Required: explicit "Required" label for first field, then asterisks thereafter with legend
Bulk destructive: threshold-based typed confirm (>=50) else single checkbox + undo
```
Ravi (Eng): Implementation note: best to expose a flag per form for 'requireTypedConfirmThreshold'. We can default 50.
Sam: copy tweak suggestion for typed confirm: "Type DELETE to confirm removing X items" not just 'delete'
Jordan (PM): Also include small accessibility line: "This action can be undone within 30 seconds" for sighted users; for screen readers include aria-live notification after action.
Elaine (Design): I'll iterate on visuals + microcopy. tagging @Ravi to sync on threshold config. Thanks :thumbsup:
Ravi (Eng): got it, will add a feature flag PR
Maya (a11y-bot): Reminder: run assistive tech QA with VoiceOver + NVDA on the new flow
Sam: ok, happy with approach — can we get a quick design spec by EOD? :eyes:
Elaine (Design): aiming EOD, will post mock and accessibility checklist
